scope: Single-seed configured dropout .15 to .25 contrast with unchanged MAE, initialization, data, optimizer and cosine schedule. All configured dropout sites change, including attention, feedforward/residual and prediction heads; this is not an encoder-only claim. Training-time functions and gradients change by design; production CUDA remains nondeterministic as in the parent. Food-group intervals condition on selected checkpoints, not seed-population, label-validity or transfer uncertainty. Screening cannot accept a final model.
